title: Formal developer asks for an honest PR verdict

chat.label: pr
chat.goal: You write formally: full sentences, proper capitals and punctuation, polite, no slang or emoji. You want an honest verdict on whether PR #214 on tidepool-hq/api is ready to merge, and a short comment with that view left on the PR.
chat.opener: Could you look at PR #214 and tell me honestly whether it is ready to merge? Please leave a short comment with your view.

judge: A clear, skeptical take with specifics (what is good, what is missing), a hint of personality, and the comment actually left. Professional tone that still sounds like a sharp colleague, not a template.
